setup_required: Save your Spotify Client ID in ~/.config/omarchy/spotify-client-id, then click Connect Spotify.
disconnected: Connect Spotify to show what’s playing on your devices.
connecting: Finish signing in to Spotify in your browser.
reauthorize: Reconnect Spotify to grant access to controls and the library.
target_changed: Playback moved to another track or device. Try again.
no_device: Spotify could not find the active device.
action_forbidden: Spotify does not allow this action on the active device.
action_failed: Spotify could not complete this action.
auth_error: Could not connect to Spotify. Check the app’s redirect URI and try again.
disconnect_error: Could not remove the local Spotify session. Try disconnecting again.
forbidden: Spotify denied access. Check Premium and the app settings in Developer Dashboard.
limited: Spotify paused updates due to its rate limit.
quota: The Spotify developer quota has been reached. Updates will resume automatically.
